name: tagNewItem

4.name: nHP
4.source: annotation — also fnPtr or PalScript base via reinterpret_cast; discriminated by dwItemID

12.name: nMP
12.source: annotation — also float via reinterpret_cast in some elements

notes: tagNewItem is a discriminated union. dwItemID determines field interpretation:
— values: nHP(int)/nGP(int)/nMP(int) for game item data
— fnPtrs: nHP/fnHP, nMP/fnMP store function addresses in editor mode
— PalScript: nHP (+4) is base of embedded PalScript for some elements (e.g. [463])
PalScript variant extends beyond 16 bytes — accessed via reinterpret_cast from nHP address.
C++ union cannot express this without changing sizeof(tagNewItem), hence the cast is inevitable.
